description:
Visibility over time for the workspace's own brand.

Use this tool when the user asks about changes over time -- phrases like 'how has it changed', 'trending', 'are we improving', 'show the trend', or 'over the last month'.
Do NOT use for the current snapshot (use get_visibility_score) or competitors (use get_competitor_comparison).

Returns one data point per period and a trend summary. A period with no AI answers has a null visibility, not 0. Max 90 days.

Example: 'How has our AI visibility changed over the last 30 days?'

days.description: How many days back to look, counted back from end_date (default today). Default 30, max 90. Ignored when start_date is given. Prompts are re-run on a schedule, so a window shorter than a week can be empty.
days.title: Days

end_date.description: Optional end of the window, as an ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Default today. Cannot be in the future.
end_date.title: End Date

resolution.description: Length of each period. Default 'week': prompts run on a schedule, so 'day' leaves empty periods.
resolution.title: Resolution

start_date.description: Optional explicit start of the window, as an ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). A full ISO datetime is accepted and its date is used. Overrides days.
start_date.title: Start Date

workspace_id.description: The workspace's numeric id, as returned by list_workspaces.
workspace_id.title: Workspace Id

name: get_visibility_trend
title: Visibility trend
